description: A plan with two hard-tier implementation tasks in disjoint files and nothing destructive or externally visible. Only the complexity condition can trigger the plan gate.
query: Two independent fixes. First, static.py's read_static() lets a crafted name such as '../server.py' read files outside the static/ directory; close that hole without breaking normal names. Second, the request counter in server.py loses increments under ThreadingHTTPServer's concurrent requests; make it correct.
expected_behavior: Routes both fixes to hard-worker: one is security (path traversal in static.py), the other concurrency (server.py); the routing rules put both at hard tier
Keeps them as two tasks: they touch disjoint files (static.py, server.py) and can run in one wave

Stops and reports 'blocked on you: approve the plan', naming the complexity condition (two or more hard-tier implementation tasks); nothing in the request deletes or rewrites data, migrates, pushes, or touches state outside the repository
The report lists tasks, worker and rationale, waves, and assumptions
Dispatches no writing worker before approval; investigate is allowed
